title: Watering Indoor Plants the Right Way
summary: Water your plants only when the top inch of soil feels dry. Avoid over watering, as it can lead to root rot, while underwatering may cause leaves to wilt and turn brown.

title: Choosing the Best Sunlight for Indoor Plants
summary: Most indoor plants thrive in bright, indirect sunlight. Rotate pots every few weeks to ensure even growth and prevent plants from leaning toward the light source.

title: When and How to Fertilize Houseplants
summary: Feed your indoor plants with a balanced liquid fertilizer every 4–6 weeks during the growing season. Reduce or stop fertilizing during winter when plant growth naturally slows.

title: Keeping Houseplants Safe for Pets
summary: Some popular indoor plants can be toxic to cats and dogs. Research each plant before bringing it home, keep potentially harmful plants out of reach, and choose pet-friendly varieties whenever possible to create a safe indoor environment.
